sections.changelog:
1.71.9

  • Facade unit tiles anchor with physical left/top (RTL pages mirrored the overlay onto the wrong tower on asymmetric buildings like DUO).
  • Fly-to-unit camera radius scales with tower height (150m fallback landed inside the crown on 150m+ towers).
  • Health endpoint reports the real plugin version (was hardcoded 1.69.67).

1.71.8

  • Rich 3D models for Ashira, Dimri Yama and DUO; engine honors explicit per-unit hotspot positions.
